lines.trans: For our next topic, let us talk about the trend of look-alike television programmes.
Right now, copycat competition across networks and streaming sites is severe.
As a result, whichever channel viewers flip to, they see the exact same kind of show.
In the bigger picture, this really reflects a shortage of original creativity.
Whenever a strong television programme launches and earns decent ratings.
It quickly sparks a wave of imitators chasing short-term gains.
Take, for instance, the familiar hit show Twelve Singers.
Among singer competition shows, I normally watch just two.
One is our Twelve Singers, and the other is the rival network's Supernova.
Yet many viewers have told us that when watching these two shows side by side.
At times people can barely tell which programme is which anymore.
If our network bosses overhear me saying that, my bonus this month is in jeopardy again!
